name: transport-map
description: Live map of ships and planes, with freight highlighted

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @tm/server" "npm run dev -w @tm/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tm/shared && npm run build -w @tm/web && npm run build -w @tm/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tm/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tm/server && npm run typecheck -w @tm/web
